question_text: What type of income was used to qualify the loan?

compile.nuance: Routing-context card: 0 defect options (all 15 answer options carry null exception_code/severity). Its selected value(s) set the income_type loan-context flag on QuestionID 570906, consumed via skip_logic by every sibling income card in this batch (income_type_employment_wage_based, income_type_commission_bonus_ot, income_type_secondary_seasonal, income_type_rental, income_type_auto_allowance, income_type_ss_retirement_disability, income_type_alimony_nontaxable, income_type_housing_assistance, income_type_anticipated_eligible, income_type_self_employment, income_type_any_qualifying_source, income_type_military, income_type_trust, income_type_restricted_stock, income_type_requires_employment_verification). No findings are ever raised by this card (taxonomy type 10).

notes: Answer set corresponds ~1:1 to Chapter B3-3's income-type taxonomy (Base/Bonus/Commission/OT, Auto/Housing Allowance, Military, Rental, Retirement/SSI/Disability, Alimony/Nontaxable, Self-Employment, Trust, Restricted Stock, Part-Time/Second-Job/Seasonal/Unemployment); cited B3-3.1-01 as the chapter's general umbrella section (income-type index) rather than any single narrow topic section.
